# `csharp_preferred_modifier_order`

Reorder modifiers to the specified preference. IDE0036. Applied without a compilation.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `<modifier-list>` | Any integer. |

**Default:** `(not set)`

## Examples

*This option accepts a freeform value. No canned example is generated.*

```ini
csharp_preferred_modifier_order = <value>
```
